'''Pokémon to the Rescue!''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンになった少年''' ''The Boy Who Became a Pokémon'') is the first chapter of the [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team]] manga.
{{spoilers}}
==Plot==
A boy named Ginji falls asleep out of fatigue looking for his birthday present and wakes up as a Torchic. After meeting a Mudkip, the two enter a fissure to rescue a Pokémon crying for help. 

They are attacked by many Pokémon on the way, such as {{p|Sunkern}}, {{p|Wurmple}}, and {{p|Rattata}} but Ginji burns them to a crisp. They find the Pokémon that was crying for help, which is a {{mdc|Caterpie|1}} trapped on top of a tall rock.

As they went to get Caterpie, a shot of silk hits Ginji. As Ginji untangles himself from the silk, Mudkip attacks with {{m|Water Gun}} against the {{p|Ariados}} that shot Ginji with its silk. Then Ginji attacks Ariados with {{m|Flamethrower}} and [[Fainting|knocks it out]]. As they return Caterpie out of the fissure, Mudkip asks if they can make a rescue team and Ginji says he will think about it.
